title: George Baquet and Charlie McCurtis
summary: Burbank saw Baquet only briefly after his return and remembers McCurtis by sight.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Do you remember George Bakke? Did you hear him? He left here pretty early, I think, with Kepard and those fellows. Do you remember hearing him, though, when you were a boy? No, I don't.

The only time I seen George Bakke or knew anything of George Bakke, of course, I had heard of him. The only time I seen George Bakke was about a couple of years before he died. When he came back? Yeah, after he came back here, I seen him working up, rap off the street and the bar up.
Another player is Charlie McCurtis. Do you remember him? Charlie McCurtis?
Charlie McCurtis. I remember him, but I remember seeing him, you know, not hearing him much. Never heard him much. No.
